# Three.js r180 / 0.180.0

The gallery vendors the unmodified ESM distribution under the included MIT license.
Retrieved 2026-10-30 from the fixed npm package CDN URLs:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/LICENSE

The gallery requires no runtime CDN connection. Existing artwork dependencies are unchanged.
If WebGL initialization or the local module fails, the HTML directory remains usable.
